verdict.rationale: The docs show a dot can connect third-party apps such as Gmail, Google Drive, GitHub, email, calendar and files, either at setup or later. Existing ChatGPT app permissions carry over to the dot, so adding apps is the product's own capability. There is no evidence of a browsable directory or catalog of third-party apps and connectors, and the breadth of available connectors is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented browsable app/connector directory, the scope of the third-party catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the add-app flow.
